findings.name: employee-shipping
findings.source:
from e=employees
join side:left o=orders (e.employee_id == o.employee_id)
derive {
 shipped = case [o.order_id != null && o.shipped_date != null => 1, true => 0],
 unshipped = case [o.order_id != null && o.shipped_date == null => 1, true => 0]
}
group e.employee_id (aggregate {shipped = sum shipped, unshipped = sum unshipped})
sort employee_id
findings.sql:
WITH table_0 AS (
  SELECT
    e.employee_id,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_id IS NOT NULL
      AND o.shipped_date IS NULL THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS _expr_0,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_id IS NOT NULL
      AND o.shipped_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS _expr_1,
    o.order_id,
    o.shipped_date
  FROM
    employees AS e
    LEFT OUTER JOIN orders AS o ON e.employee_id = o.employee_id
)
SELECT
  employee_id,
  COALESCE(SUM(_expr_1), 0) AS shipped,
  COALESCE(SUM(_expr_0), 0) AS unshipped
FROM
  table_0
GROUP BY
  employee_id
ORDER BY
  employee_id

findings.name: freight-ratio
findings.sql:
WITH totals AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount)), 0) AS price
  FROM
    order_details
  GROUP BY
    order_id
),
priced AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    COALESCE(t.price, 0) AS price,
    COALESCE(o.freight, 0) AS freight
  FROM
    orders AS o
    LEFT OUTER JOIN totals AS t ON o.order_id = t.order_id
),
table_0 AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(p.price), 0) AS _expr_0,
    COALESCE(SUM(p.freight), 0) AS _expr_1
  FROM
    customers AS c
    LEFT OUTER JOIN priced AS p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
  GROUP BY
    c.customer_id
)
SELECT
  customer_id,
  CASE
    WHEN _expr_0 = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (_expr_1 * 1.0 / _expr_0)
  END AS freight_ratio
FROM
  table_0
ORDER BY
  customer_id
